description: This file defines a 'Home' component for a LightningJS/Blits-based frontend application. It imports external components and libraries, sets up a visual template with animated elements, and manages component state and lifecycle hooks for animations and interactions.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the homepage with animated logo, loader, and text, including lifecycle hooks for animations and a method to rotate loader colors.

methods.name: rotateColors
methods.description: Cycles through predefined colors array, updating the component's color property at specified intervals.
